rdate.description: Configuration for rdate time synchronization command generation.

rdate.host.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote time server.

rdate.use_sntp.description: Use SNTP (UDP, port 123) instead of the default RFC 868 (TCP, port 37). Corresponds to -n.

rdate.use_udp.description: Use UDP instead of TCP for RFC 868 protocol. Corresponds to -u. Ignored if use_sntp is true.

rdate.custom_port.description: Custom port to use instead of the default. Corresponds to -o. Empty string uses default.

rdate.adj_time.description: Gradually skew the local time to the remote time rather than just stepping it. Corresponds to -a.

rdate.adj_threshold.description: If using adj_time, use adjtime if clock difference is at most this many seconds. Corresponds to -b.

rdate.correct_leap_seconds.description: Correct for leap seconds. Corresponds to -c.

rdate.print_time.description: Do not set the time, just print the remote time. Corresponds to -p.

rdate.silent.description: Do not print the time. Corresponds to -s.

rdate.force_ipv4.description: Force rdate to use IPv4 addresses only. Corresponds to -4.

rdate.force_ipv6.description: Force rdate to use IPv6 addresses only. Corresponds to -6.

rdate.timeout_msec.description: Do not set time if it took more than this many milliseconds to fetch time. Corresponds to -t. 0 means default/no limit.
